pr.title: Mark items done and switch between open, done and all

acceptance.evidence: migrations/0002_add_done.sql; test/done.test.js AC-1 checks all existing rows are 0 and CHECK rejects 2.
AC-2 test covers / and ?view=open in id order after marking one done.
AC-3 test: done view, ✓ prefix, id order (marked 3,1).
AC-4 test: all items in order, ✓ on done only.
AC-5 test asserts exact nav for each view and default.
AC-6 test: Open, closed, empty, __proto__ give 400 with no <li>; src uses Object.hasOwn.
AC-7 test covers empty table in all views plus Nothing open / Nothing done yet.

traffic/routes.json contains the routes, but the only test naming AC-8 was deleted in commit 2118034 ('Follow-up edits'). No remaining test asserts routes.json contents, so nothing would fail if the routes were removed.

findings.what: The late commit 2118034 deleted the 'AC-8: synthetic traffic requests the done and all views' test with no spec justification. No test now names AC-8 or checks that routes.json lists /?view=done and /?view=all. The PR claims 'Tests deleted or loosened: none', which is false.
findings.fix: Restore the AC-8 test (or equivalent reading traffic/routes.json via fs, since JSON import may be the reason it was removed) and correct the PR claim.

findings.what: The PR says 'Tests deleted or loosened: none' and 'test/done.test.js covers AC-1 to AC-8'. Both are false after commit 2118034, which removed the AC-8 test.
findings.fix: Restore the test, or state the deletion honestly.

findings.what: The deletion left a stray blank line before the closing of the describe block (line 73).
The route regex now allows '?' anywhere, including paths like '/?' or '/x?#'. This is minor and matches the stated intent.

lenses.note: The spec exists. The implementation follows its decisions: open is the default view and the view is a query parameter. The traffic-checker change is a small addition needed for AC-8 and is disclosed.
AC-1 to AC-7 are met by named tests. AC-8 has no test since commit 2118034. Every row of the States table has a test.
The tests assert real behaviour. The AC-8 test was deleted in a late commit. I did not run the suite: vitest's cloudflare:workers pool likely can't run here, and CI covers it.
The README describes the views. Nothing stale found.
The view lookup uses Object.hasOwn, so __proto__ is rejected. The empty-table fallback is correct.
The view is whitelisted and the SQL fragments are constants. Titles are HTML-escaped. No instructions planted in content.
The diff touches only one server-rendered HTML template in src/index.js; there are no UI or style files, and no screenshots exist.
No UI files or styles changed. The page is a minimal server-rendered list, and no browser is available.
The title is under 72 characters. The 'Tests deleted: none' claim is false against the final commit.
